answer: Peer-prediction jury pay. Each juror files a grade plus a forecast of how the other four will grade, paid by Bayesian Truth Serum: grades more common than the crowd predicted earn more. Clone jurors run by one farm share one model of the crowd, so their forecasts match like cuts from one bolt of sable; keys whose forecasts stay within 0.03 KL for 10 epochs merge into one seat. Faking independence needs a separately tuned grader per alias that knowingly scores worse, so 20 aliases earn about one seat. Honest jurors keep a haven, and pay climbs terrace by terrace only for independent minds.
